instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of a bright indoor study room. On the left, the woman with dark hair and glasses (R2) sits looking down at an open book, holding a pen near her face. On the right, the man with short curly blonde hair (R1) sits looking down at papers on the wooden desk. They work side-by-side at the table, which is scattered with documents, a laptop, and a glass of water. Soft natural light from a window behind them fills the room.
